source: flutter\_translate keeps plural forms as nested keys. From version 4, the forms are the Intl plural names {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} and {5}. Before version 4, they were {6}, {7}, {8} and {9}. The preset adds a derived key {10} for each of these forms, so the {11} check does not report the forms of a used key.
text: flutter\_translate conserve les formes plurielles sous forme de clés imbriquées. À partir de la version 4, les formes sont les noms de pluriel Intl {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} et {5}. Avant la version 4, il s'agissait de {6}, {7}, {8} et {9}. Le preset ajoute une clé dérivée {10} pour chacune de ces formes, de sorte que la vérification {11} ne signale pas les formes d'une clé utilisée.
